About Hamerkop

Enterprise technology for institutions that need systems to work every day.

Based in Addis Ababa, Hamerkop Systems is an Ethiopian enterprise technology company helping institutions replace fragmented processes and aging technology with reliable, governed systems for day-to-day operations.

Company

Built to make complex technology work in the real world.

What we work on

Hamerkop works across enterprise resource planning, electronic invoicing, financial technology, identity, systems integration, data and managed technology services.

Who we work with

Our work is focused on organizations operating in complex or regulated environments, including private companies, financial institutions, government bodies, healthcare providers and development organizations.

Our purpose

Make institutional technology more reliable, connected and useful.

Engagement starts with

  • Current operational challenges
  • Legacy system constraints
  • Compliance and reporting requirements
  • Existing systems and integration needs
  • The sequence required to move from current state to a stable working environment
